resources.string: A calm, text-only home screen that helps you use your phone on purpose. Let\'s set it up. Every step can be skipped.
Pick a theme and a typeface. Everything changes as you tap, and you can change it again in Settings.
Pick up to %1$d apps for your home screen. Everything else is one swipe up.
Make Shunya your home screen, so the Home button brings you here. You can switch back any time in your phone\'s settings.
Shunya isn\'t your home app yet.
Both are optional. Shunya works without them, and you can change them later in Settings, Permissions.
Shows your screen time and makes daily limits work. Shunya reads which apps you used and for how long. It stays on this phone.
Lets Shunya hold notifications from apps you choose in a quiet inbox, only if you turn Hold on. Nothing leaves your phone.
Swipe up for all your apps. Long-press the home screen for the quick menu and Settings.
